summary: Tiki is a wiki-based content management system and groupware application written in PHP and distributed under the LGPL-2.1 licence. It provides a collaborative platform combining wiki pages, content management capabilities, and team communication features within a single package.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you need an all-in-one collaboration suite and wiki platform built on traditional PHP infrastructure.
watchOut: The repository shows minimal recent activity and lacks tagged releases, which may indicate maintenance stagnation or an unmonitored development lifecycle.
deployNotes: As a PHP application, it typically requires a web server such as Apache or Nginx, alongside a relational database like MySQL or MariaDB to handle persistent storage.
